comments.text: This is a strange thing, I don't understand it, all the variants are accessible for the mentioned brands. Should we ignore that?
In code we have both tertiary and tertiaryLink while the seconds one is the same as first one so should it be removed?

items.title: Corner radius isn't linked to a variable in Figma
Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
Text contrast is too low in Figma
Figma "Show Icon Left" is "leftIcon" in code

comments.text:
Transferred to design - review doc section 4 (Transfer to design), item 1.
Figma "Show Icon Left" and the code prop "leftIcon" express the same capability, and both sides already support it. This is a property-naming alignment, not a code defect: the fix belongs in Figma (rename the property to match the code convention).
Marking this issue as ignore; no code change planned.
